angle: Movement translation, DL (clearest of five groups screened, Fig 2C): each lineman's tracked Combine 40 start (combine_frames) laid over his own random NFL pass-rush starts (game_frames_sample). Translation does not explain pressure beyond pick (carry-over rho 0.07 [-0.14, 0.28] after size, n=67; per-player translation scores <= 0.18; carry-over delta R2 -0.08 [-0.17, 0.01]). Agreement between the official 40 time and the NFL first step ('Both') is a ranking edge on held-out classes, tested with matched pairs and a hashed 2026 pre-registration.
metric_name: First step (speed 0.3-0.5 s after first movement, sd after weight and role) and the 'Both' rule: NFL first step in the top third AND official 40 time in the top half, cut-offs set on the other two classes
headline_number: Both rushers beat a held-out pick/weight/role pressure forecast 8 of 10 (80% [55, 94] Jeffreys) vs 16 of 59 for the rest (base rate 35% [26, 45]); gap 53 pts [28, 75]; frozen 2024 call scored on 2025 vs own past 6 of 7 vs 6 of 16. Baseline without tracking: held-out R2 0.43 [0.24, 0.61], RMSE 2.1 pts, rho 0.45 (stronger baseline with 40 + NGS: 0.48 / 2.0 / 0.51). Continuous delta R2: NFL first step -0.06 [-0.21, 0.05], official 40 0.00, Both flag 0.04 [-0.04, 0.14] -> a ranking edge, not a regression gain.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_16/cand_3 (8.19), applying its noted flaws and the round-16 judges' top_changes by analogy. Data science: baseline held-out R2 with class-stratified bootstrap interval, RMSE and rank correlation for both no-tracking baselines; every measure in Table 1 now carries a held-out delta R2 with interval (including the Both flag and the carry-over translation score), and the text states plainly that no speed measure raises held-out R2 (matches public audits); hit rates vs base rate with Jeffreys intervals in Table 2 and Fig 3B; shuffle p values moved to the appendix. Football: lede defines first step and Both before stating the result; translation question answered explicitly ('does not explain production beyond pick'); 'what would change the call' added to the pre-registration (8 of 11 hits needed; rule dropped if list does no better than the rest, 6% likely at half the edge, 50% under no edge); veteran-edge price moved into motivation; hand-picked Johnson/Jean-Baptiste illustration dropped (all pairs shown); film hypothesis labelled. Viz: Fig 2 title no longer overclaims ('small edge that varies by class'); Fig 3B and Fig 4B frozen-call counts reconciled and labelled (6 of 7 vs own past, 4 of 7 vs twin, same seven calls); Fig 1 headline numbers in the title; Fig 3B Jeffreys intervals and gap labels. Pre-registration hash unchanged (e3079960bd2d). check.py: 1,981 words, 5 figures, 3 tables.
open_risks: Continuous delta R2 is null or negative for every speed measure, including the NFL first step that carries the held-out slope; the paper's value rests on a 10-man shortlist, which judges may see as a selection-on-the-tail result
The two-signal form was chosen after seeing all three classes; only cut-offs are held out. 2026 is the first blind test and power at half the observed gap is 32%
Beyond the stronger baseline (official 40 + NGS get-off), the Both flag's delta R2 is -0.04 [-0.11, 0.03]; Table 2 row 2 still shows a 35-pt gap but with a wide interval
Matched-pair sign tests are not significant (career p 0.17, frozen p 0.50); day-3 evidence is 3 shortlisted rushers
Five figures; Fig 5 (snap mechanism) could be cut if the judges want economy
